title: Take Five
studio_context: Columbia's 30th Street Studio, New York, 1959; produced by Teo Macero. Recorded 1 July 1959.

drum_performances.name: Joe Morello
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Written by Desmond to showcase his 5/4 playing, and "supposed to be a Joe Morello drum solo": the 5/4 groove every drummer learns, and ninety bars of solo over the vamp.

notable_moments.description: The ride on 1, 2 and its "and", 3, 4 and its "and", 5; the snare on the "and" of 2 and on 4 with the vamp, ghosts round them; the foot on 2 and 4.
The time kept and talked over, then bursts of sixteenths on the snare answered by silence and the bass drum, then the toms, the vamp under all of it.

drums.description: A 5/4 ride pattern split 3+2 with a rim click, then a famous melodic drum solo over the piano vamp.
